rules: When answering questions, retrieving documentation, or analyzing code related to underlying normative specifications (e.g., OID4VCI, OID4VP, RFC 9449 DPoP, RFC 9101 JAR, W3C DID Core, SD-JWT VC):

- You MUST always cross-reference queries against the corresponding Swiss Profile (`swiss-profile-anchor`, `swiss-profile-issuance`, `swiss-profile-verification`, `swiss-profile-vc`, or `trust-protocol-2-0`).
- Always check if the Swiss Profile restricts, overrides, or disables optional/standard features of the base RFC or specification.
- Precedence Rule: In the swiyu E-ID ecosystem, Swiss Profile restrictions ALWAYS take precedence over generic base standards.
